scope: Additive CHI-GB historical partial-game and quarterback role reconciliation. It resolves five source-bound partial-game cases and the injury-driven Caleb Williams full-game quarterback absence under the approved v1.9 faster-closeout convention, while preserving Benjamin St-Juste and complete reserve-list/paired assembly as explicit blockers. It does not mark the game READY, stage a rating change, alter the active manifest or current-week overlays, construct a fair, or issue a bet.

sources.finding: The official final gamebook supplies the 31-7 final, final lineups/substitutes/inactives/DNPs, and the printed no-return injury sequences. It binds last confirmed duty at Q2 11:59 for T.J. Edwards, Q1 2:37 for Dayo Odeyingbo, Q3 13:33 for Tyrique Stevenson and Q1 0:46 for Skyy Moore; first non-return statuses at Q2 8:13, Q3 13:04, Q3 8:40 and Q2 13:30 respectively; and Javon Hargrave's injury on the Q4 2:00 play. Return-questionable or return-doubtful is not treated as an actual return.

Chicago's official depth chart identifies Jack Sanborn as an active reserve linebacker, Daniel Hardy directly behind Dayo Odeyingbo, Clark Phillips behind Tyrique Stevenson and Josh Blackwell as the other active reserve boundary corner. The final gamebook records Phillips DNP and Sanborn, Hardy and Blackwell as substitutes, supporting labelled documented-depth estimates for only the vacated additional duties.

Green Bay's official depth chart lists Bo Melton behind Skyy Moore at receiver, Melton as Moore's kick-return successor, Matthew Golden as Moore's punt-return successor and Jonathan Ford behind Javon Hargrave. The final gamebook confirms all four participants and Golden's punt-return and Melton's receiving/return duties.

Green Bay's official final game updates confirm Bagent started for the injured Caleb Williams, Keenum entered in the fourth quarter, Moore left injured, and the documented Melton/Golden receiving and return work occurred after Moore's departure.

The official postgame recap describes Keenum replacing Bagent in the fourth quarter as a performance change rather than a second injury-driven quarterback loss, and confirms Hargrave's late injury departure.

NFL.com reports Tyson Bagent would start because Caleb Williams was injured and Case Keenum would be the second quarterback, binding Bagent as the primary injury replacement without relabelling the later performance benching.

checklist.resolvedFinding: The five resolved partial-game estimates contribute 0.946 points of Chicago injury loss and 0.030 points of Green Bay injury loss before the still-blocked St-Juste and full paired reserve-list assembly. Caleb Williams contributes a separate 3.250-point full-game historical QB loss through primary injury replacement Tyson Bagent; Keenum's same-valued fourth-quarter performance substitution creates no second injury adjustment. These are reusable case inputs, not complete team totals.

partialCaseReviews.baselineDutyTreatment: Sanborn retains his baseline reserve/special-teams duty; only Edwards' vacated additional linebacker duty is allocated. D'Marco Jackson already started and is not counted again.
partialCaseReviews.assumptionRationale: The final gamebook lists Sanborn as an active substitute, while Chicago's other documented Edwards-branch backups were already starting or inactive. Sanborn is the source-backed game-available unallocated linebacker candidate; the allocation remains a labelled role estimate.

unavailableInterval.rationale: Last confirmed duty at Q2 11:59 and first return-questionable status at Q2 8:13 bound the departure; the later OUT notice and no recorded return extend the interval through the final.

partialCaseReviews.baselineDutyTreatment: Hardy's existing baseline duty remains in the board baseline; only Odeyingbo's vacated additional edge duty is allocated.
partialCaseReviews.assumptionRationale: Chicago's official depth chart lists Hardy directly behind Odeyingbo and the final gamebook lists Hardy as an active substitute. This is a labelled documented-depth allocation, not claimed snap-share evidence.

unavailableInterval.rationale: Last confirmed duty at Q1 2:37 and first return-questionable status at Q3 13:04 bound the departure; later return-doubtful text is not a return and no return is recorded.

partialCaseReviews.baselineDutyTreatment: Blackwell retains his existing baseline reserve duty; only Stevenson's vacated additional boundary-corner duty is allocated. Clark Phillips is not used because the official final gamebook records him DNP.
partialCaseReviews.assumptionRationale: The official depth chart and final participation identify Blackwell as the active, participating, unallocated reserve boundary-corner candidate after the documented Stevenson backup did not play. The primary allocation is explicitly an estimate.

unavailableInterval.rationale: Last confirmed duty at Q3 13:33 and first return-doubtful status at Q3 8:40 bound the departure; no return is recorded.

partialCaseReviews.baselineDutyTreatment: Melton and Golden retain their baseline duties; the committee allocates only Moore's vacated receiver and return duties. The candidates' actual role types are source-bound, while equal additional-role shares are explicit because no common-unit shares were published.
partialCaseReviews.assumptionRationale: Official depth and final participation establish a genuine two-player Moore relief set but not comparable workload shares. Equal additional-role allocation is the approved transparent estimate and is sensitivity-invariant after the no-upgrade floor because both candidate values are at least Moore's 0.2.

partialCaseReviews.baselineDutyTreatment: Ford retains his baseline reserve duty; only Hargrave's vacated final two minutes of additional defensive-tackle duty are allocated.
partialCaseReviews.assumptionRationale: Green Bay's official depth chart places Ford behind Hargrave and the final gamebook lists Ford as an active substitute. The exact departure play binds a narrow exposure rather than imputing a whole-game loss.

unavailableInterval.rationale: The official gamebook marks Hargrave injured on the Q4 2:00 play and no return is recorded.

historicalQuarterbackReview.baselineDutyTreatment: Bagent is assigned Williams' injury-vacated full-game starting duty. Case Keenum's later same-valued performance substitution is preserved as observed but does not create a duplicate injury loss.
historicalQuarterbackReview.assumptionRationale: Official NFL and gamebook evidence directly bind Bagent as the injury replacement starter. Bagent and Keenum share the same frozen value, so the performance relief timeline does not change the source-bound replacement value.

resolvedSubtotalOnly.warning: These subtotals contain only the cases resolved in this additive bundle. They are not governed team injury totals and must not be staged or used in Walters arithmetic until complete paired coverage passes.

blockers.finding: Benjamin St-Juste is source-bound as an active substitute who became return-questionable after Q3 1:58 and did not return, but the official record does not provide a last confirmed defensive/special-teams duty or measured added-duty allocation between Carrington Valentine and Kamal Hadden. Treating the status time as the departure or his full frozen value as a starter role would overstate the evidence.
blockers.nextAction: Obtain source-bound St-Juste participation timing or snap-role evidence, then apply an explicit bounded exposure and primary/equal-share additional-duty model without duplicating the existing Valentine/Hadden baseline.
